digest.component_or_area: s3_doctor module / gitutil store self-healing seam
propositions: s3_doctor._git calls gitutil.run_git directly without retry wrapper or advisory lock, leaving it outside rebar's self-healing seam while all other store write paths inherit transient-fault recovery via run_git_write

The observed CI failure 'fatal: bad object HEAD' is git's get_reference() path when a merge commit object is absent from the ODB at bundle time, proven by experiment to be a transient read blip not data corruption
The same missing-object fault class is already self-healed in event_append and other store paths via _TRANSIENT_HEAD_MARKERS and _with_transient_head_retry, yet s3_doctor lacks the marker
s3_doctor._git must route through gitutil.run_git_write to inherit per-store advisory git-op lock, bounded index/ref-lock retry, and transient read-fault retry without growing a fourth private retry
Bundle operations are idempotent reads and scratch-file rewrites satisfying run_git_write's idempotency precondition, enabling safe retry of transient faults
S3DoctorConflict error hint misdescribes ODB read failure as heads conflict, sending operators to wrong recovery tool
